[[File:Atama plant.jpg|thumb|Atama plant]] '''Atama soup''' or '''amme-eddi''' is a palm-fruit vegetable soup that originates from the [[Ibibio people]] of [[Akwa Ibom State|Akwa Ibom state, Urhobo and Isoko people of Delta State]] in South South [[Nigeria]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.nigerianbulletin.com/threads/top-exotic-nigerian-dishes-you-must-taste-this-week.188054/|title=Top Exotic Nigerian Dishes You Must Taste This Week|newspaper=Nigerian Bulletin - Nigeria News Updates|access-date=2017-02-21|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://leadership.ng/features/551690/ikot-ekpene-the-raffia-city|title=Ikot Ekpene: The Raffia City {{!}}|website=leadership.ng|language=en-US|access-date=2017-02-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170221105810/http://leadership.ng/features/551690/ikot-ekpene-the-raffia-city|archive-date=2017-02-21|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=omotolani |date=2021-05-27 |title=How to make Akwa Ibom's Abak Atama soup |url=https://www.pulse.ng/lifestyle/food-travel/how-to-make-akwa-iboms-abak-atama-soup/h1hzpse |access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[Pulse Nigeria]]|language=en}}</ref> It is a popular food among the Delta, Cross River and [[Akwa Ibom State]] people of Nigeria. The Urhobo people of Delta state called it amme-edi or banga soup ("banga" being a colloquial Nigerian-English term).<ref>{{Cite news |date=2016-12-17 |title=The 'finger-licking' Abak Atama soup everyone is talking about! |url=https://tribuneonlineng.com/finger-licking-abak-atama-soup-everyone-talking/ |access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[Nigerian Tribune]]|language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-10-01 |title=Google celebrates Nigerian food culture in new online platform|url=https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertainment/naija-fashion/355491-google-celebrates-nigerian-food-culture-in-new-online-platform.html,%20https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertainment/naija-fashion/355491-google-celebrates-nigerian-food-culture-in-new-online-platform.html |access-date=2022-06-27 |language=en-GB|newspaper=[[Premium Times]]}}</ref> The soup is made from [[Palm kernel oil|palm fruit-pulp that is derived from palm fruit]]; the extracted palm-pulp is base primary ingredient for the soup. Atama soup (Abak Atama) is  thick and dark brown in color. It is normally prepared with Atama leaf, choice of protein like fresh meat or dry meat(mostly bush meat), dry fish, fresh fish and sometimes shrimp(dry or fresh), periwinkle as added proteins for more enhanced flavor.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2017-07-11 |title=How to prepare Abak Atama Soup |url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2017/07/prepare-abak-atama-soup/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Top Five Tasty Nigerian Soups For Tourists :: Bestnaira.com |url=https://news.bestnaira.com/posts/view/top-five-tasty-nigerian-soups-for-tourists |access-date=2022-06-27 |website=news.bestnaira.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2018-05-28 |title=How to cook the delicious atama soup |url=https://www.pulse.ng/lifestyle/food-travel/food-recipe-how-to-cook-the-delicious-atama-soup/0l9skw5 |access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[Pulse Nigeria]]|language=en}}</ref> Ingredients: primary ingredients are Fresh Atama leaf,fresh palm-pulp sourced from palm fruit, salt and pepper and secondary ingredients which are decided based on preference of the cooker are onions, salt, pepper(different kinds of pepper are preferences)  and different kinds of spices could be added depending on the cooker preferred or desired taste or flavor. This soup could be styled into different flavors depending on cooking preferences. Every added ingredient could drastically change the taste of the food.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Dami |date=2021-04-30 |title=How to Make Abak Atama Soup 
|url=https://allure.vanguardngr.com/2021/04/how-to-make-abak-atama-soup/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-07-07 |title=How To Prepare The Delicious Abak Atama Soup 
|url=https://guardian.ng/life/food/how-to-prepare-the-delicious-abak-atama-soup/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2022-06-27 |newspaper=[[The Guardian (Nigeria)|The Guardian]]|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Soups, Stews and Sauces |url=https://ounjealadun.com/category/soups-stews-and-sauces/ |access-date=2022-06-27 |website=Ounje Aladun |language=en-GB}}</ref>
